text:
Curly locks, lawlessly unbound, Midas once held; black stars kindled in snow.


Roses anticipating spring, defended from time; dawns rising in laughter, guarded by carnation.


Living planets of heaven, through which Lisi rules freedoms bound in their lights.


She is a rational sphere lighting earth, where Love reigns over all she sees and lives in all she kills.

translation.title: Curly Locks, Lawlessly Unbound...
